svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 14 October to 10 November 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 798 contributions on 27 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
OCT 14 – NOV 10 · 798 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 27 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST NOV 08 (144), IN VERMILION
